rows.question: Show me the object id, right ascension and declination of photometrically observable Galaxy that have spectral observations.
rows.pred_sql:

  SELECT
    objid,
    ra,
    dec
  FROM photoobj
),
specobj_basic AS (
  SELECT
    specobjid,
    bestobjid,
    class
  FROM specobj
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(pb.objid, ps.objid) AS object_id,
  COALESCE(pb.ra, ps.ra) AS ra,
  COALESCE(pb.dec, ps.dec) AS dec

  AND COALESCE(pb.dec, ps.dec) IS NOT NULL

  SELECT
    s.specobjid,
    s.bestobjid,
    -- carry all specobj columns explicitly with specobj. prefix
    s.plateid,
    s.scienceprimary,
    s.segue2primary,
    s.survey,
    s.programname,
    s.mjd           AS spec_mjd,
    s.plate         AS spec_plate,
    s.fiberid,

    s.zwarning,
    s.class         AS spec_class,
    s.subclass      AS spec_subclass,
    s.veldisp,
    s.veldisperr,
    s.loadversion   AS spec_loadversion,
    -- carry all photoobj columns explicitly with photoobj. prefix (may be null)
    p.objid         AS photo_objid,
    p.run           AS photo_run,
    p.rerun          AS photo_rerun,
    p.field         AS photo_field,
    p.mode          AS photo_mode,
    p.type          AS photo_type,
    p.clean         AS photo_clean,
    p.flags         AS photo_flags,
    p.rowc          AS photo_rowc,
    p.colc          AS photo_colc,
    p.cmodelmag_u,
    p.cmodelmag_g,
    p.cmodelmag_r,
    p.ra            AS photo_ra,
    p.dec           AS photo_dec,
    p.b             AS photo_b,
    p.l             AS photo_l,
    p.extinction_r,
    p.mjd           AS photo_mjd,

    p.i             AS photo_i,

  SELECT

    run,
    rerun,
    field,
    mode,
    type,
    ra,
    dec,
    u,
    g,
    r,
    i,
    z
  FROM photoobj
),
-- consider neighbors in either direction so we can list the primary star of the binary
neighbors_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    n.objid,
    n.neighborobjid,
    n.distance
  FROM neighbors n
  WHERE n.distance < 0.05
),
-- include rows where the photoobj is either the objid (primary) or the neighborobjid (primary)
photoobj_with_close_neighbor_candidates AS (

    p.run,
    p.rerun,
    p.field,
    p.mode,
    p.type,
    p.ra,
    p.dec,
    p.u,
    p.g,
    p.r,
    p.i,
    p.z,
    nf.neighborobjid,
    nf.distance
  FROM photoobj_basic p
  JOIN neighbors_filtered nf
    ON p.objid = nf.objid
  UNION
  SELECT
    p2.objid,
    p2.run,
    p2.rerun,
    p2.field,
    p2.mode,
    p2.type,
    p2.ra,
    p2.dec,
    p2.u,
    p2.g,
    p2.r,
    p2.i,
    p2.z,
    nf2.objid AS neighborobjid,
    nf2.distance

SELECT

  field,
  mode,
  type,
  ra,
  dec,

  g,
  r,
  i,
  z,

  (g - r) AS computed_g_minus_r,
  (r - i) AS computed_r_minus_i,
  (i - z) AS computed_i_minus_z,

  distance
FROM photoobj_with_close_neighbor_candidates
WHERE
  u IS NOT NULL
  AND g IS NOT NULL
  AND r IS NOT NULL
  AND i IS NOT NULL
  AND z IS NOT NULL
  AND (u - g) < 0.4
  AND (g - r) < 0.7
  AND (r - i) > 0.4
